project.name: Netty Native Library Elimination
project.description: Eliminate Netty native transport libraries (kqueue/epoll) by replacing with JEP 380 pure-Java NIO domain sockets. Root cause: Native library double-loading crashes GraalVM isolates. Solution: Use NioEventLoopGroup/NioDomainSocketChannel everywhere (Java 16+, Netty 4.1.110+).

current_state.phase: Phase 1: Code Migration - Replace Netty Native Transports

phases.name: Code Migration - Replace Netty Transports
phases.description: Replace all domain socket channel creation to use NioEventLoopGroup/NioDomainSocketChannel instead of platform-specific KQueue/Epoll transports
phases.success_gate: Code compiles, all protocol tests pass (without native libraries loaded)
key_deliverables: Replace domain socket initialization in 5 modules
Code review of all transport layer changes

phases.name: Module Deletion
phases.description: Delete domain-kqueue, domain-epoll, domain-sockets modules entirely from pom.xml and filesystem
phases.success_gate: Modules removed, parent pom.xml references cleaned

phases.name: GraalVM Metadata Cleanup
phases.description: Remove native library metadata from isolates module (resource-config.json, references to native libraries)
phases.success_gate: Native library metadata cleaned, reachability-metadata.json updated
key_deliverables: Update isolates/pom.xml (remove native profiles or adapt)

phases.name: Testing and Validation
phases.description: Comprehensive testing to ensure NIO transport works everywhere, no terminal hangs, isolates work correctly
phases.success_gate: All tests pass (unit, integration, isolates), no terminal hangs, performance acceptable

sequence: Phase 3: Metadata cleanup (remove native library references)

team.notes: Estimated 3 weeks for complete elimination (greenfield approach, not incremental)

phase_1_complete: All 5 modules updated to use NIO transport
phase_3_complete: No references to native library loading
phase_4_complete: All test suites pass (unit, integration, isolates)

blockers.description: Terminal hang risk from previous isolate testing - requires careful testing strategy
blockers.impact: Must avoid terminal crashes during validation phase
blockers.mitigation: Implement safe testing approach (minimal reproducers, file logging, no interactive testing)

blockers.description: Netty NIO domain socket compatibility across platforms (Windows/Linux/macOS)
blockers.impact: May discover platform-specific issues during testing
blockers.mitigation: Test on each platform incrementally, start with macOS/Linux

blockers.description: GraalVM isolates JNI compatibility with pure-Java NIO transport
blockers.impact: Isolates may fail if NIO transport incompatible with native image
blockers.mitigation: Test isolates early in Phase 1, iterate quickly

blockers.description: Peer credential extraction for Unix domain sockets (may not work with NIO)
blockers.impact: May lose capability to verify socket peer credentials
blockers.mitigation: Research JDK/Netty support for SO_PEERCRED, fallback strategy

performance_degradation.description: Pure Java NIO may be slightly slower than native Epoll/KQueue

terminal_hang_risk.description: Previous isolate testing caused terminal hangs - greenfield approach carries some risk
terminal_hang_risk.mitigation: Extremely meticulous testing, minimal reproducers, file logging only
